info.title: Plan API
info.description:
Backend for **Plan**, an NFL-first sports betting web app (**play money only**).

* Auth: email + password (argon2id). Returns a JWT (`Authorization: Bearer ...`) and also sets an
  httpOnly cookie; either works.
* Money: all amounts are **integer cents** of play currency (`PLAY`).
* Odds: American odds (e.g. `-110`, `+150`). Sample odds are **not real**.
* Errors: `{"error": {"code", "message", "details"}}`.
* Paywall: 10 free tries per user (one try = unlocking one prop), then credit packs bought via
  Stripe Checkout. `GET /auth/me` returns `usage`. Gated endpoints return **402**
  `UPGRADE_REQUIRED` (`details.reason`: `prop_locked` | `out_of_tries`). Stripe is **test mode only**.

post.description: Create an account (with a play-money wallet + welcome credits) and log in.
Revoke the current session and clear the cookie.

get.description: Current user plus paywall `usage` (UI hints; the server enforces gating).

schema.title: Response List Teams Api V1 Teams Get

get.description:
Weekly board (shape mirrors plan-frontend/mock/data.js). Auth optional.

Paywall: props the caller hasn't unlocked show only the `hitRate.last5` teaser; `season` and
`vsOpp` are null, `unlocked=false`, and the withheld fields are listed in `prop.locked`.
Listing never consumes tries.

schema.title: Response List Games Api V1 Games Get

get.description: Game with markets + props (paywall-filtered like the board). Auth optional; free.
Props list (same objects/filtering as GameBoardOut.props). Free.

schema.title: Response Get Game Props Api V1 Games  Game Id  Props Get

get.description:
Prop hit-rate detail. Auth required. **This is the metered action: 1 try.**

Free tries are used first (FREE_TRIES, default 10 per user), then purchased tries.
Re-opening the same prop within the re-open window (same ET day by default) is free, so
refreshes/retries never double-charge. `charged` says whether this call used a try.
402 UPGRADE_REQUIRED (details.reason=out_of_tries, with packs) when none remain.

One hit-rate window (never consumes a try). `L5` follows the board teaser; `season`
requires the prop detail to have been opened in the re-open window (402 prop_locked).

Vs-opponent split (never consumes a try). 402 UPGRADE_REQUIRED (prop_locked) until the
prop detail has been opened in the re-open window.

schema.title: Response Get Prop Vs Opponent Api V1 Games  Game Id  Props  Prop Id  Splits Vs Opponent Get

post.description: Price a bet slip at current odds without placing it (powers the live bet slip).

Place a single or parlay bet.

Validates selections are open, the submitted odds/lines still match (409 `ODDS_CHANGED`
otherwise, unless `accept_odds_changes`), stake limits, and play-money balance.
Debits the stake via the wallet ledger. Retrying with the same `idempotency_key` returns the
original bet with HTTP 200.

get.description: Play-money balance (integer cents). No real-money deposits/withdrawals exist.

Pricing: free tries + credit packs. Works without Stripe keys (falls back to config prices).
Includes the caller's `usage` when authenticated.

post.description:
Hosted Stripe Checkout for a credit pack (one-time payment, `mode=payment`).

The client sends only a pack key; the server maps it to a Price lookup key. Tries are
credited by the webhook (or the success-page sync), never by this call.

get.description:
Free tries, purchased balance and recent purchases from OUR DB.

With `session_id` (success page), the Checkout Session is fetched from Stripe and fulfilled
if paid — idempotent with the webhook, so tries are credited exactly once.

schema.description: cs_… from the success page; syncs that purchase from Stripe immediately

parameters.description: cs_… from the success page; syncs that purchase from Stripe immediately

post.description:
Stripe webhook receiver. No JWT; the `Stripe-Signature` header is mandatory.

Idempotent by event id; always re-fetches the subscription so delivery order doesn't matter.
